description: Calibrate LONRF3 RING scores against the annotated human RING-domain proteome
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
url=('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query=organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true+AND+ft_zn_fing:RING'
     '&format=tsv&fields=accession,gene_primary,sequence')
r=requests.get(url,timeout=600); print('HTTP',r.status_code)
open('human_ring.tsv','w').write(r.text)
D=pd.read_csv('human_ring.tsv',sep='\t').dropna(subset=['Sequence'])
print('human reviewed proteins with an annotated RING-type zinc finger:', len(D))
def ligs(s):
    return [[m.start(i)+1 for i in range(1,9)] for m in
            re.finditer(r'(?=(C).{2}(C).{9,39}(C).{1,3}([HC]).{2,3}([HC]).{2}(C).{4,48}(C).{2}(C))', s)]
HYD=set('AVLIMFWCY')
FR=[('L2-1',1,-1),('L2+1',1,1),('L6+4',5,4),('L7+1',6,1),('L8-1',7,-1),('L8+1',7,1)]
rows=[]
for acc,gene,s in zip(D['Entry'],D.get('Gene Names (primary)',pd.Series(['']*len(D))),D['Sequence']):
    for k,L in enumerate(ligs(s)):
        d=dict(acc=acc,gene=gene,span=f'{L[0]}-{L[7]}',idx=k+1)
        for lab,i,off in FR:
            p=L[i]+off; d[lab]=s[p-1] if 1<=p<=len(s) else '-'
        d['score']=int(sum([d['L2-1'] in HYD, d['L2+1'] in HYD, d['L8-1'] in HYD,
                            d['L6+4'] in HYD, d['L7+1']=='P', d['L8+1'] in 'RK']))
        rows.append(d)
A=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print('RING instances scored:',len(A),'in',A.acc.nunique(),'proteins')
def pick(acc,span):
    q=A[(A.acc==acc)&(A.span==span)]
    return int(q.score.values[0]) if len(q) else None
marks={'LONRF3 RING2 (467-504)':pick('Q496Y0','467-504'),'LONRF3 RING1 (158-195)':pick('Q496Y0','158-195'),
       'LONRF2 RING (449-486)':pick('Q1L5Z9','449-486'),'LONRF1 RING2 (479-516)':pick('Q17RB8','479-516'),
       'LONRF1 RING1 (123-158)':pick('Q17RB8','123-158'),'BARD1 (50-86, inactive partner)':pick('Q99728','50-86'),
       'RNF4 (132-176)':pick('P78317','132-176'),'BIRC7 (252-285)':pick('Q96CA5','252-285'),'CBL (381-419)':pick('P22681','381-419')}
print('\nE3-competence score (0-6)'); 
for k,v in marks.items(): print(f'  {k:34s} {v}')
dist=A.score.value_counts().sort_index()
print('\nDistribution across all human RING instances:')
for k,v in dist.items(): print(f'  score {k}: {v:5d}  ({100*v/len(A):4.1f}%)')
print('\nlinchpin Arg/Lys in %.1f%% of human RING instances; Pro at L7+1 in %.1f%%'%(
    100*A['L8+1'].isin(list('RK')).mean(), 100*(A['L7+1']=='P').mean()))
print('percentile of LONRF3 RING2: %.1f | LONRF3 RING1: %.1f'%(
    100*(A.score<marks['LONRF3 RING2 (467-504)']).mean(), 100*(A.score<marks['LONRF3 RING1 (158-195)']).mean()))
A.to_csv('human_ring_proteome_scores.csv',index=False)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.6,5))
ax.bar(dist.index,dist.values,color='#c7c7c7',edgecolor='k',lw=0.4)
for lab,c,h in [('LONRF3 RING2 (467-504)','#1f77b4',0.96),('LONRF3 RING1 (158-195)','#d62728',0.80),
                ('BARD1 (50-86, inactive partner)','#555555',0.64)]:
    ax.axvline(marks[lab],color=c,lw=2.2)
    ax.text(marks[lab]-0.05,dist.max()*h,lab+' ',color=c,fontsize=9,va='top',ha='right')
ax.set_xlabel('E3-competence score (hydrophobic at L2-1, L2+1, L6+4, L8-1; Pro at L7+1; Arg/Lys linchpin at L8+1)')
ax.set_ylabel('number of RING instances')
ax.set_title('LONRF3 RINGs against %d C3HC4 RING instances in %d human reviewed RING proteins'%(len(A),A.acc.nunique()),fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
